checks: Settings offers one available-voice list, one preview and eight themes, with no sex selection
The speech slider shows a live value, saves on release, and previews each selected voice at that speed
Preview captures the live speed without waiting for a slider change event or altering saved preferences
Preview and Stop share one button without moving or losing keyboard focus; pause, end, errors and cancellation restore Preview
Refresh is hidden initially, appears only for voice edits or phone settings, and hides immediately when clicked
The highlighted Refresh button is readable and distinct in all eight themes; Preview and Stop occupy identical rectangles at phone and tablet sizes
Every theme applies immediately and gives readable body, secondary and button text
A failed settings write rolls back the theme and retains the last saved profile choices
Voice and theme choices survive a locked reload; a second profile keeps independent settings
Read lesson uses the saved voice and speed while leaving lesson text and highlights untouched
Pause, resume and stop ignore stale engine completions and never continue a cancelled passage
Long lessons advance through bounded chunks and exclude unrelated hidden text, collapsed details and button labels
Navigation and signing out stop narration; another profile cannot inherit pending speech
Unavailable saved voices are explained and retained until another available voice is chosen
Settings and reading controls fit small phones, landscape and tablets in light and dark themes
